answer: Last month a 300-key pool cleared onboarding because every key answered probes from the same model revision and the fingerprint check was optional. Make it mandatory and verify each claim against held-out probes, so a clone pool at the jetty must pay for 300 distinct deployments to pass, a failed audit slashes the bond and leaves the shale of failed probes on the ledger, and the honest agent running one model keeps the nectar of its unbroken streak.
